subject: Islamic Studies

source: Written for islamic-studies/y9 lesson 23 (Pupil PDF worksheet: qiyas practice cases)
intro: Lesson 23: How the madhhabs reach rulings: Qur'an, Sunnah, ijma and qiyas. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

model.title: Are modern drugs that intoxicate haram?

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: Haram by qiyas; the Prophet ﷺ also said 'every intoxicant is haram' (Muslim)

panels.title: Ijma'
points: When all qualified scholars of an age agree
Example: the five daily prayers are obligatory
Ijma' rests on the Qur'an and Sunnah

head: New case
Original case
Reason ('illah)
Ruling, or why qiyas does not apply
rows: Missing Jumu'ah for a football match

blocks.answers: E-cigarettes that intoxicate: original wine (5:90), reason intoxication, so haram. Online gambling: original maysir (5:90), reason chance winnings and losses and enmity, so haram. Energy drinks: they do not intoxicate, so this qiyas does not apply (judge by harm instead). Missing Jumu'ah for football: no qiyas needed; Jumu'ah is obligatory, so a match is not an excuse.

keywords.def: analogy: applying a ruling to a new case with the same reason

questions.q: Use qiyas: the Qur'an forbids saying 'uff' to parents (17:23). What about hitting them? Explain.
questions.a: Even more forbidden: the reason is harm and disrespect, which is greater in hitting.

questions.q: Qiyas practice on the pupil PDF: four new cases (e-cigarettes that intoxicate, online gambling, energy drinks, missing Jumu'ah for a football match): identify the original case, reason and ruling, or explain why qiyas does not apply.
questions.a: Reasoned answers; e.g. online gambling: same as maysir (5:90), haram; energy drinks: no intoxication, so not by that qiyas

questions.q: Extend: why must qiyas be done by scholars?
questions.a: The reason must be identified correctly from the evidence.

questions.q: Stretch: how can two scholars differ using the same source?
questions.a: They may identify a different 'illah or know different hadith.

questions.q: Applying a ruling to a new case with the same reason is ...
questions.a: A) Qiyas. Qiyas uses the shared 'illah.

questions.q: The reason behind a ruling is the ...
Think again: how do scholars know drugs are haram?
questions.a: By qiyas on wine: the same reason, intoxication; and 'every intoxicant is haram' (Muslim).
